details:
**Updated for SDK - Base 3.1.7**

I've noticed this problem and helped multiple customers of mine who purchase my avatars.
# Description
If you have a scene with multiple avatars, **and one of them has an issue**, the builder fails to function.
# How to replicate
- You can purposefully duplicate your imported avatar FBX without a rig (with an avatar descriptor in the same scene) 
and/or
- Switch build to android and have an avatar that has an unsupported shader (while also having a valid quest compatible avatar)
# Where and what file?
*Packages\com.vrchat.base\Editor\VRCSDK\Dependencies\VRChat\ControlPanel\VRCSdkControlPanelBuilder.cs*
Multiple Changes in method (see video or my comment of changes below)
- Line 86
`public virtual void ShowBuilder()`
